title: Image requests got less fragile
summary:
Image generation got sturdier while the app showcase and documentation had their shelves rearranged.

Nunchaku now serializes GPU work to prevent concurrent CUDA hangs, detects out-of-memory errors, and caps requests at 810,000 pixels. An empty `model` parameter now falls back to `zimage`, so `polli gen image` works without an explicit `--model` flag.

URV AI Chat joined the catalog with multi-model chat, character creation, and image generation. The community also removed the Argent Script and Mirexa AI Chat listings; those catalog changes do not affect the apps or Pollinations APIs.

APIDOCS.md shrank from 94 KB to 37 KB by cutting repeated errors and empty examples. The generated `llm.txt` reference now covers account and media endpoints, including usage, API key management, uploads, and retrieval. These are documentation changes, not new endpoints.
